vibe: Elite Collector Display Case. Moody, premium, high-contrast, with neon accents to highlight deals.

layout_and_spacing.feed_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6 md:gap-8
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous padding: p-6 or p-8 inside cards to let images and data breathe.
layout_and_spacing.borders: 1px solid border, rounded-none or max rounded-sm for a sharp, tactical look.

deal_card.wrapper: relative group overflow-hidden bg-[#111111] border border-white/10 transition-colors duration-300 hover:border-[#00E5FF]/40
deal_card.image: w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:scale-110
deal_card.discount_badge: absolute top-4 right-4 bg-[#00E5FF] text-[#050505] font-mono font-bold px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,229,255,0.4)] z-10

header.wrapper: sticky top-0 z-50 w-full backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#050505]/80 border-b border-white/10
header.nav: flex items-center justify-between h-20 max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8

add_deal_form.input: w-full bg-black/50 border border-white/20 focus:border-[#00E5FF] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#00E5FF] text-white p-4 font-mono transition-all
add_deal_form.button: bg-[#F5D90A] text-[#050505] font-bold py-4 px-8 hover:bg-white transition-colors uppercase tracking-widest

motion.feed_stagger: Framer Motion: Initial opacity 0, y 20, staggerChildren 0.1s for feed entry.
motion.hover_effects: Subtle scale on images (scale-110), glow/shadow shift on borders.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT use Inter or Roboto fonts anywhere. Implement Unbounded, Outfit, and JetBrains Mono.
Always apply 'data-testid' to interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='post-link-card', data-testid='add-deal-button').
Maintain the Luxury/Cyberpunk blend: dark UI, crisp 1px borders, neon accents, and no muddy gradients.
Use framer-motion for staggering the feed entries and hover interactions.
Ensure all E1 guidelines for layout (asymmetry, wide gaps, generous padding) are followed.
Create a succinct product card that clearly displays the discount badge, current price (highlighted), and original price (muted, strikethrough).
The empty state and add-deal form should feel premium and integrated, not just a standard Shadcn modal.
Use Phosphor icons or Lucide for UI iconography, ensuring sharp, consistent weights.
